ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_DREAM_RELIC.title: Cradle of Dreams
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_DREAM_RELIC.descri: At the start of each combat, gain 1 [gold]Dream[/gold].
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_DREAM_RELIC_PLUS.d: At the start of each combat, gain 3 [gold]Dream[/gold].
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_WRISTBAND_RELIC.fl: A tiny message is written inside the wristband: Remember to train hard today, too.
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_MICROPHONE_RELIC.d: Whenever you apply [gold]Song[/gold], apply 1 additional stack.
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_ENERGY_BAR_RELIC.d: The first {FreeAttacks} [gold]Attacks[/gold] you play each combat do not consume [gold]Dream[/gold].
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_STICKER_RELIC.desc: Whenever you enter [gold]Magic Lulu[/gold] form, draw {Cards} cards.
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_RED_BEAN_BREAD_REL: Milk, green tea, or orange juice to go with it?
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_ENCORE_RELIC.title: Encore
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_ENCORE_RELIC.descr: When an enemy dies, transfer its [gold]Song[/gold] and [gold]Intoxication[/gold] stacks to ALL enemies.
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_BACKPACK_RELIC.des: Upon pickup, choose {Cards} cards in your deck. They gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_QUEST_BOOK_RELIC.d: Generates four random quests to help Arale collect Band Souls.
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_QUEST_BOOK_RELIC.f: "Civilization advanced because we weren't afraid of fire."
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_YUNO_SOUL_RELIC.de: The first two times you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from cards each turn, it is increased by your [gold]Dream[/gold].
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_YUNO_SOUL_RELIC.fl: "Generate season two of Mugendai for me."
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_RITSU_SOUL_RELIC.d: Whenever you enter [gold]Magic Lulu[/gold] form, draw 2 cards.
ARALE_MOD_RELIC_ARALE_NONO_SOUL_RELIC.de: [gold]Intoxication[/gold] causes enemies to lose 4 additional HP and applies 1 [gold]Weak[/gold].
Whenever a card is [gold]Retained[/gold], reduce its Energy cost by 1 for this combat.
